text:
meera: heads-up, eu-1 is seeing a late surge of 503s on inference paths since 22:40 UTC. impact looks concentrated on kvcache lookups. need an expedited hotfix, possible TTL bump and small kv eviction tweak. asking for fast-track approvals. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: hotfix candidate built: v2026.3.1. artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/v2026.3.1.tar.gz. Default pipeline wants a 10m canary at 1% -> 5% -> 20%. change window requested 23:15-00:15 UTC. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/kvcache-hotfix

alex: can do canary signoff if we keep the staged rollout and close monitoring. what are the rollback criteria?

meera: rollback if 5xx rate > 1.5% or median latency +50% over baseline. otherwise progress. but given traffic, i'm asking: can we run a deadman override — pin to 5% for 15m and then pause for manual go/no-go? avoids full-scale churn.

sanjay: current production 5xx 4.2% on eu-1, baseline 0.4%. agree to manual freeze at 5% for inspection. prefer manual rollback rather than auto if we see OOM traces.

tess: +1 to manual pause. I'm oncall, can monitor dashboards and logs. :thumbsup:

alex: +1. If we need speed, I can approve skipping the 1% step and start at 5% canary with deadman/manual hold. Note: ensure metrics export to infra-alerts and tracing is enabled for kv keys.

meera: ok deploying with override flag `--canary-start=5% --deadman=manual` now. command: 
```
make deploy HOTFIX=v2026.3.1 ENV=prod-eu1 EXTRA_FLAGS="--canary-start=5% --deadman=manual"
```

deploy-bot: deploy initiated by meera. canary target 5% (20 pods). expected rollout start 23:18 UTC. will post progress.

deploy-bot: canary progress: 5% -> health checks passing (latency +8%, 5xx down to 2.1%). waiting 10m for team signoff.

meera: seeing initial improvement on kvcache hit rate. keep monitoring for memory.

sanjay: spotted a recurring OOM pattern in worker-8 logs at 23:26: 
```
2026-03-19T23:26:12Z worker-8 OOMKilled: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError
stack: ...
```
Suggest hold and investigate; possible memory regression in the new runtime path.

alex: we should scale the kv-worker and cap concurrent in-flight requests on new pods. can we pause further rollout?

meera: pausing rollout. do not progress to 20%. we need immediate decision: rollback to v2026.3.0 or patch quick fix and re-run canary. timebox 10m.

tess: given OOMs, I vote rollback. risk of cascading failures if we go to 20%. I approve rollback now.

sanjay: +1 rollback. I'll prepare logs and a short blameless blurb for postmortem.

alex: +1 rollback. please include CPU/mem profiles from canary pods.

meera: rollback approved by oncall and infra. initiating rollback.

deploy-bot: rollback started: rolling to v2026.3.0 across canary pool. target completion ETA 23:38 UTC.

deploy-bot: rollback completed at 23:37:30 UTC. canary pool reverted to v2026.3.0. health checks returning to baseline (5xx -> 0.6%, latency back to normal).

meera: thanks all. we'll hold change window and schedule a follow-up retro. creating a ticket for a proper fix + perf regression triage. Link: https://go/issues/RD-4921

alex: FYI: recommend we add a memory smoke test to canary pipeline before next push to avoid same regression.

meera: noted. will file infra PR for memory gating. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
